name: michael.brancazio
description: Michael Brancazio Portfolio & AI Chatbot Worker

scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:voice
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run check:site && npm run build && npm run deploy:check
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply portfolio-chat-db --config wrangler.jsonc --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply portfolio-chat-db --config wrangler.jsonc --remote
scripts.logs: wrangler d1 execute portfolio-chat-db --config wrangler.jsonc --remote --command 'SELECT id, timestamp, input_mode, model_used, latency_ms, status FROM chat_logs ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 25;'
